text: [image: Broward Health Medical Center in Fort Lauderdale]HealthcareEnsuring Accessible Healthcare & Protecting Reproductive FreedomHealthcare is a fundamental human right, not a privilege for those who can afford it. We must take immediate action to expand Medicaid, lower the crushing cost of prescription drugs, and firmly protect reproductive rights from government overreach."I will always stand against efforts to restrict reproductive freedom and work tirelessly to expand healthcare access so every family gets the care they need."Read more

[image: Cypress Bay High and Falcon Cove Middle Schools in Weston, Broward County]EducationFully Funding Public Education & Supporting Our TeachersOur public schools are the foundation of our community's future. For too long, we've watched as public funds are diverted to unaccountable private institutions while our local classrooms remain underfunded. We must ensure every child has access to a world-class public education regardless of their zip code."I promise to champion our public school system, fight for meaningful teacher pay raises, and expand access to quality early childhood education."Read more

[image: Fort Lauderdale skyline along the Intracoastal Waterway, Broward County]EconomyTackling the Property Insurance Crisis & Strengthening Our EconomyFlorida's families are being squeezed by skyrocketing property insurance premiums and an out-of-control cost of living. While working families struggle to make ends meet, corporate special interests continue to get handouts in Tallahassee. We need an economy that builds from the bottom up and the middle out."I will fight to lower property insurance rates, support local small businesses, and build an economy that works for every Floridian, not just the wealthy few."Read more
